about_the_game:
The Archive is incomplete. What remains has been stitched back together—part instruction, part confession, part tomb.

This optional DLC contains the Magical Textbook & Artbook for Mortal Advocate, a richly illustrated 24-page PDF featuring:

🩸 Detailed Magic Lore – Learn how Holy, Neutral, and Profane magic are classified and manipulated. Understand the systems behind Servitor construction, and uncover how the Empire uses metaphysics to bind bodies and rewrite minds.

🪶 Developer Commentary – Notes from the creator exploring the philosophy and inner machinery of the game's world, from psychic interfaces to soul logic.

🧠 Character Portraits – Full-page illustrated portraits of key characters like Zegg, Glee, Tybalt, and others. Rendered in a stark, expressionist style that blends ink, ash, and memory.

📜 Production-Grade Layout – Designed like an in-world manual: half sacred text, half forbidden operating guide, this book is meant to feel like a lost object retrieved from the Empire itself.

Whether you're a lore completionist, an art collector, or simply want to support the continued development of weird, meaningful games... this PDF is for you.
